title: Being said 'because he's here'
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: He said because he's here. And they didn't say didn't say my name, didn't say his name, just said because he's here.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says that in 1977, in the nuclear missile field at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a being he met told him something had happened "because he's here", pointing to another man without naming either of them. Woods tells Michels he was there, on an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens: "They didn't say my name, didn't say his name, just said because he's here." If it happened, the beings singled out one of the two men for a reason.
